13: pin_project! {
14:     /// A future to write some of the buffer to an `AsyncWrite`.
15:     #[derive(Debug)]
16:     #[must_use = "futures do nothing unless you `.await` or poll them"]
17:     pub struct WriteAllBuf<'a, W: ?Sized, B> {

25: /// Tries to write some bytes from the given `buf` to the writer in an
26: /// asynchronous manner, returning a future.
27: pub(crate) fn write_all_buf<'a, W, B>(writer: &'a mut W, buf: &'a mut B) -> WriteAllBuf<'a, W, B>
28: where
29:     W: AsyncWrite + Unpin + ?Sized,
30:     B: Buf,
31: {
32:     WriteAllBuf {
33:         writer,
34:         buf,
35:         _pin: PhantomPinned,
36:     }
37: }
38: 
39: impl<W, B> WriteAllBuf<'_, W, B>
40: where
41:     W: AsyncWrite + Unpin + ?Sized,
42:     B: Buf,
43: {
44:     pub(super) fn poll_copy<R>(
45:         &mut self,
46:         copy: &mut CopyBuffer,
47:         cx: &mut Context<'_>,
48:         mut reader: Pin<&mut R>,
49:     ) -> Poll<io::Result<u64>>
50:     where
51:         R: AsyncRead + ?Sized,
52:     {
53:         let user_remaining = self.buf.remaining();
54: 
55:         ready!(crate::trace::trace_leaf(cx));
56:         #[cfg(any(
57:             feature = "fs",
58:             feature = "io-std",
59:             feature = "net",
60:             feature = "process",
61:             feature = "rt",
62:             feature = "signal",
63:             feature = "sync",
64:             feature = "time",
65:         ))]
66:         let coop = ready!(crate::runtime::coop::poll_proceed(cx));
67:         loop {
68:             if copy.cap < copy.buf.len() && !copy.read_done {
69:                 let mut read_buf = ReadBuf::new(&mut copy.buf[..]);
70:                 read_buf.set_filled(copy.cap);
71:                 let unfilled = read_buf.remaining();
72:                 let fill_res = if unfilled == 0 {
73:                     Poll::Ready(Ok(()))
74:                 } else {
75:                     reader.as_mut().poll_read(cx, &mut read_buf)
76:                 };
77:                 match fill_res {
78:                     Poll::Ready(Ok(())) => {
79:                         if unfilled > 0 {
80:                             let filled_len = read_buf.filled().len();
81:                             let initialized_len = read_buf.initialized().len();
82:                             copy.read_done = copy.cap == filled_len;
83:                             copy.cap = filled_len.min(initialized_len);
84:                         }
85:                         #[cfg(any(
86:                             feature = "fs",
87:                             feature = "io-std",
88:                             feature = "net",
89:                             feature = "process",
90:                             feature = "rt",
91:                             feature = "signal",
92:                             feature = "sync",
93:                             feature = "time",
94:                         ))]
95:                         coop.made_progress();
96:                     }
97:                     Poll::Ready(Err(err)) => {
98:                         #[cfg(any(
99:                             feature = "fs",
100:                             feature = "io-std",
101:                             feature = "net",
102:                             feature = "process",
103:                             feature = "rt",
104:                             feature = "signal",
105:                             feature = "sync",
106:                             feature = "time",
107:                         ))]
108:                         coop.made_progress();
109:                         return Poll::Ready(Err(err));
110:                     }
111:                     Poll::Pending => {
112:                         if user_remaining.saturating_add(copy.cap.saturating_sub(copy.pos))
113:                             == user_remaining
114:                         {
115:                             if copy.need_flush {
116:                                 ready!(Pin::new(&mut *self.writer).poll_flush(cx))?;
117:                                 #[cfg(any(
118:                                     feature = "fs",
119:                                     feature = "io-std",
120:                                     feature = "net",
121:                                     feature = "process",
122:                                     feature = "rt",
123:                                     feature = "signal",
124:                                     feature = "sync",
125:                                     feature = "time",
126:                                 ))]
127:                                 coop.made_progress();
128:                                 copy.need_flush = false;
129:                             }
130: 
131:                             return Poll::Pending;
132:                         }
133:                     }
134:                 }
135:             }
136: 
137:             while copy.pos < copy.cap {
138:                 let n = {
139:                     match Pin::new(&mut *self.writer).poll_write(cx, &copy.buf[copy.pos..copy.cap]) {
140:                         Poll::Pending => {
141:                             if !copy.read_done && copy.cap < copy.buf.len() {
142:                                 let mut read_buf = ReadBuf::new(&mut copy.buf[..]);
143:                                 read_buf.set_filled(copy.cap);
144:                                 if read_buf.remaining() > 0 {
145:                                     ready!(reader.as_mut().poll_read(cx, &mut read_buf))?;
146:                                     let filled_len = read_buf.filled().len();
147:                                     let initialized_len = read_buf.initialized().len();
148:                                     copy.read_done = copy.cap == filled_len;
149:                                     copy.cap = filled_len.min(initialized_len);
150:                                 }
151:                             }
152:                             return Poll::Pending;
153:                         }
154:                         Poll::Ready(Ok(n)) => n,
155:                         Poll::Ready(Err(err)) => return Poll::Ready(Err(err)),
156:                     }
157:                 };
158:                 #[cfg(any(
159:                     feature = "fs",
160:                     feature = "io-std",
161:                     feature = "net",
162:                     feature = "process",
163:                     feature = "rt",
164:                     feature = "signal",
165:                     feature = "sync",
166:                     feature = "time",
167:                 ))]
168:                 coop.made_progress();
169:                 if n == 0 {
170:                     return Poll::Ready(Err(io::Error::new(
171:                         io::ErrorKind::WriteZero,
172:                         "write zero byte into writer",
173:                     )));
174:                 } else {
175:                     copy.pos += n;
176:                     copy.amt += n as u64;
177:                     copy.need_flush = true;
178:                 }
179:             }
180: 
181:             debug_assert!(
182:                 copy.pos <= copy.cap,
183:                 "writer returned length larger than input slice"
184:             );
185: 
186:             copy.pos = 0;
187:             copy.cap = 0;
188: 
189:             if copy.read_done {
190:                 ready!(Pin::new(&mut *self.writer).poll_flush(cx))?;
191:                 #[cfg(any(
192:                     feature = "fs",
193:                     feature = "io-std",
194:                     feature = "net",
195:                     feature = "process",
196:                     feature = "rt",
197:                     feature = "signal",
198:                     feature = "sync",
199:                     feature = "time",
200:                 ))]
201:                 coop.made_progress();
202:                 return Poll::Ready(Ok(copy.amt));
203:             }
204:         }
205:     }
206: }
207: 
208: impl<W, B> Future for WriteAllBuf<'_, W, B>
209: where
210:     W: AsyncWrite + Unpin + ?Sized,
211:     B: Buf,
212: {
213:     type Output = io::Result<()>;
214: 
215:     fn poll(self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
216:         let me = self.project();
217:         while me.buf.has_remaining() {
218:             let n = ready!(Pin::new(&mut *me.writer).poll_write(cx, me.buf.chunk())?);

221:                 return Poll::Ready(Err(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero.into()));
222:             }
223:         }

225:         Poll::Ready(Ok(()))
226:     }

Implemented vectored IO for `write_all_buf` in tokio/src/io/util/write_all_buf.rs:215:

- `poll` now checks `is_write_vectored()` once before the loop.
- For vectored writers, it fills a fixed-size array of 4 `io::IoSlice`s via `Buf::chunks_vectored` and calls `poll_write_vectored`, refilling the slices each iteration as chunks are advanced/consumed.
- Non-vectored writers keep the original single-chunk `poll_write` path, preserving the `WriteZero` error behavior.
